# TypePin

> TypePin (钉字 / 釘字) is a free, browser-only newspaper text match-cut studio at typepin.com: pin a word in the frame, export a 1080p MP4 or WebM with no watermark, no account, and no upload for rendering.

TypePin runs entirely in the visitor’s browser. Layout, sound, and encoding stay on the device. You can paste up to 4,000 characters of copy, load a local .ttf / .otf / .woff / .woff2 font, choose 9:16, 1:1, or 16:9, and cut at 2–30 cuts per second for a 2–12 second clip (capped at 360 cuts; 60 fps when the peak rate is above 15). Built-in pages are typographic stand-ins, not real newspapers. Switch the UI with `?lang=en`, `?lang=zh`, or `?lang=hant`.

钉字是免费的浏览器端文字跳切工具：词钉在画面中间，成片无水印，不登录，不为渲染上传内容。

About, privacy, terms, cookies, and the disclaimer currently live as hash sections on the homepage. `about.html` and `legal.html` redirect to those hashes. There is no standalone `/privacy` or `/contact` page yet; if those clean URLs ship later, this file should be updated to match.

## Pages

- [TypePin studio](https://typepin.com/): the editor; canonical home
- [Studio](https://typepin.com/#studio): jump straight to the editor section
- [English](https://typepin.com/?lang=en): English UI
- [简体中文](https://typepin.com/?lang=zh): Simplified Chinese UI
- [繁體中文](https://typepin.com/?lang=hant): Traditional Chinese UI
- [FAQ](https://typepin.com/#faq): usage, export, privacy, and commercial-use questions
- [How to use](https://typepin.com/#how): in-page six-step walkthrough
- [About](https://typepin.com/#about): project and contact (hi@typepin.com)
- [About (file)](https://typepin.com/about.html): stub that redirects to `#about`
- [Privacy](https://typepin.com/#privacy): privacy policy
- [Terms](https://typepin.com/#terms): terms of use
- [Cookies](https://typepin.com/#cookies): cookie notice
- [Disclaimer](https://typepin.com/#disclaimer): fictional mastheads and usage limits
- [Legal (file)](https://typepin.com/legal.html): stub that redirects to the legal hashes

## Optional

- [robots.txt](https://typepin.com/robots.txt): allows crawlers; points to the sitemap
- [sitemap.xml](https://typepin.com/sitemap.xml): indexable URLs (currently includes the hash routes above)
